title: Vaporesso Armour Max Vape Kit -  iTank T Version
description: The Vaporesso Armour Max Kit with iTank T combines unprecedented durability with cutting-edge vaping performance, making it a perfect choice for sub-ohm vapers who demand power and resilience, and only the best from their favourite high-VG e-liquids. The Armour Max mod is constructed from advanced Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) material, providing impact and scratch resistance making it ideal for active lifestyles or just everyday use, all while maintaining a practical, ergonomic design. Capable of delivering up to 220W of adjustable output, the Armour Max is powered by dual 21700 batteries (sold separately), providing long-lasting performance for extended vaping sessions, as well as the facility to swap batteries on the fly. Adapters for dual 18650 batteries are also included, offering additional flexibility. The device features Vaporesso’s advanced AXON chipset, which provides intuitive vaping modes such as Pulse Mode for consistent performance, ECO Mode for extended battery life, and DIY Mode for tailored settings. A convenient Uni-Lock system enhances safety by securing the fire and lock buttons. Paired with the innovative iTank T, this kit takes vaping to the next level. The iTank T is a robust 2ml sub-ohm tank with Vaporesso's Turbo Airflow System for optimised airflow, delivering smoother vapour and enhanced flavour. Compatible with Vaporesso's GTi mesh coils, the tank comes pre-installed with a 0.2ohm coil (ideal for 60-75W) and includes a 0.4ohm coil (best at 50-60W) as a spare, ensuring a satisfying Direct-to-Lung (DTL) experience. Its top-fill design and leak-resistant construction make the iTank T as practical as it is powerful. With its superior build quality, customisable performance, and exceptional tank technology, the Vaporesso Armour Max Kit with iTank T is designed for sub-ohm vapers seeking power, durability, and unmatched flavour production. Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
